doll with glass eyes still bright. But nothing like this. The bottle was green, salt-frosted, sealed with wax the colour of dried blood. Inside, a strip of paper no wider than a finger. She unrolled it at the kitchen table while the lamp above her hummed. The handwriting was cramped and urgent: coordinates, a date three weeks past, and a single line — \"They don't know we survived.\" Maren looked out at the grey water, then reached for the radio. Some messages, she decided, couldn't wait for the morning tide.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市还没有完全睡着，也还没有醒来。街灯将橘黄的光晕泼在潮湿的柏油路上，偶尔一辆出租车驶过，尾灯如流星一闪而逝。便利店的玻璃门后，收银员趴在柜台上打盹，荧光灯白得让人心疼。远处，环卫工人推着车，扫帚与地面摩擦发出沙沙的声响，像是城市在轻声呢喃。高楼的某扇窗还亮着灯，不知是谁在熬夜，对抗着这寂静。空气里有露水的凉意，混着隔夜油烟的气息。整座城市悬在黑夜与黎明之间，像一口长长的、尚未吐出的气。", "w03": "• Recursion is when a function calls itself to solve a smaller version of the same problem, like looking up a word in a dictionary and finding the definition uses another word you need to look up.\n• Every recursive function needs a \"base case\" — a simple situation where it just gives the answer without calling itself again, so it doesn't loop forever.\n• Think of it like a set of Russian nesting dolls: each doll opens to reveal a smaller one, until you reach the tiniest doll that doesn't open — that's your base case."}
